Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

How Reliable is Multilingual LLM-as-a-Judge? (ACL-2025.findings-emnlp.587-published) · paper method: Cross-language consistency is measured using Fleiss’ Kappa,treating each language-specific output as a rater’s judgment.

cohort7.claim.multijudge.agreement

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report; experiments, raw datasets, consent forms, labor records and formal derivations were not independently reproduced or audited.
  • The paper separately considers accuracy/grade because high consistency alone can reflect uniformly incorrect judgments. No kappa-to-accuracy conversion is made.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

How Reliable is Multilingual LLM-as-a-Judge? (ACL-2025.findings-emnlp.587-published) · paper method: The experiments use datasets with parallel data and treat ground-truth answers as the answers being judged.

cohort7.claim.multijudge.parallel-answers

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report; experiments, raw datasets, consent forms, labor records and formal derivations were not independently reproduced or audited.
  • Tasks include extractive QA,math QA,summarization,dialogue generation and translation; ground-truth substitution maintains alignment rather than sampling erroneous model outputs.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

How Reliable is Multilingual LLM-as-a-Judge? (ACL-2025.findings-emnlp.587-published) · paper method: The experiments use pointwise judgments with both binary Yes/No and1–5 score criteria.

cohort7.claim.multijudge.pointwise

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report; experiments, raw datasets, consent forms, labor records and formal derivations were not independently reproduced or audited.
  • Not pairwise preference evaluation; choice is motivated by difficulty obtaining parallel multilingual candidate responses.

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
